_source: Real what-if Modify changes and read-only read-backs from the unchanged infsim lab (2026-11-17), sanitised: subscription and every GUID replaced consistently; workbook content shortened (the real 309 KB workbook compared equal). Only changeType, resourceId and delta are kept.

delta.after:
<fragment>
    <!-- Forwarding. A streamed request ("stream": true) is relayed chunk by chunk (buffer-response
         false, owner approval (d)); any other request is forwarded as the service scope's bare
         forward-request does, with the platform defaults. This section does not inherit the service
         scope, so a change there does not reach this API. -->
    <choose>
      <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("ccofStream", false))">
        <forward-request buffer-response="false" />
      </when>
      <otherwise>
        <forward-request />
      </otherwise>
    </choose>
  </fragment>

<fragment>
    
    <!-- 12. Errors raised by a policy, answered in Anthropic's error shape. The limits are told apart by
         policy id; nothing from context.LastError.Message reaches the caller. A request that matches no
         operation of the API (APIM's built-in step: source configuration, reason OperationNotFound), such
         as Claude Code's HEAD /api/hello connection-warming probe, comes here before any other policy
         has run: it is answered 404 not_found_error, with nothing forwarded and nothing counted. -->
    <set-variable name="ccofErrorKind" value="@{
        var source = context.LastError.Source ?? "";
        var policy = context.LastError.PolicyId ?? "";
        var reason = context.LastError.Reason ?? "";
        var status = context.Response.StatusCode;
        if (source == "validate-jwt") { return "jwt"; }
        if (policy == "ccof-admission-person") { return "admission_person"; }
        if (policy == "ccof-admission-resolver" || policy == "ccof-admission-resolver-concurrency") { return "admission_resolver"; }
        if (policy.StartsWith("ccof-limit-family-group-", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return status != 429 && (status == 403 || reason.Contains("Quota")) ? "family_group_quota_exceeded" : "family_group_rate_exceeded"; }
        if (policy.StartsWith("ccof-limit-family-person-", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return status != 429 && (status == 403 || reason.Contains("Quota")) ? "family_person_quota_exceeded" : "family_person_rate_exceeded"; }
        if (policy.StartsWith("ccof-limit-group", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return status == 403 || reason.Contains("Quota") ? "group_quota" : "group_rate"; }
        if (policy.StartsWith("ccof-limit-person", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return status == 403 || reason.Contains("Quota") ? "person_quota" : "person_rate"; }
        if (policy.StartsWith("ccof-backend-credential", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return "backend_credential"; }
        if (reason == "BackendConnectionFailure") { return "backend_unreachable"; }
        if (reason == "Timeout") { return "backend_timeout"; }
        if (source == "configuration" && reason == "OperationNotFound") { return "not_found"; }
        return "unexpected";
    }" />
    <choose>
      <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("ccofResolverCalled", false) && !context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<bool>("ccofResolverTraced", false) && context.Variables.ContainsKey("ccofResolverOutcome"))">
        <trace source="ccof.resolver.v1" severity="information">
          <message><![CDATA[@{
              var budget = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("ccofResolverBudgetState", "");
              return new JObject(
                  new JProperty("schemaVersion", 1),
                  new JProperty("requestId", context.RequestId.ToString()),
                  new JProperty("observedAt", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
                  new JProperty("resolverOutcome", (string)context.Variables["ccofResolverOutcome"]),
                  new JProperty("resolverDurationMs", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<long>("ccofResolverMs", 0)),
                  new JProperty("budgetState", budget == "" ? null : budget),
                  new JProperty("served", false)).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
          }]]></message>
        </trace>
      </when>
    </choose>
    <set-variable name="ccofErrorStatus" value="@{
        var kind = (string)context.Variables["ccofErrorKind"];
        if (kind == "jwt") { return 401; }
        if (kind == "admission_person" || kind == "admission_resolver" || kind == "group_rate" || kind == "person_rate") { return 429; }
        if (kind == "family_group_rate_exceeded" || kind == "family_person_rate_exceeded") { return 429; }
        if (kind == "group_quota" || kind == "person_quota") { return 403; }
        if (kind == "family_group_quota_exceeded" || kind == "family_person_quota_exceeded") { return 403; }
        if (kind == "backend_credential") { return 503; }
        if (kind == "backend_unreachable") { return 502; }
        if (kind == "backend_timeout") { return 504; }
        if (kind == "not_found") { return 404; }
        return 500;
    }" />
    <set-variable name="ccofErrorRetryAfter" value="@{
        var kind = (string)context.Variables["ccofErrorKind"];
        if (kind == "admission_resolver" || kind == "backend_credential") { return "5"; }
        if ((kind == "admission_person" || kind.EndsWith("_rate") || kind.EndsWith("_quota") || kind.EndsWith("_rate_exceeded") || kind.EndsWith("_quota_exceeded")) && context.Variables.ContainsKey("ccofRetryAfter")) {
            return Convert.ToString(context.Variables["ccofRetryAfter"]);
        }
        return "";
    }" />
    <set-variable name="ccofErrorBody" value="@{
        var kind = (string)context.Variables["ccofErrorKind"];
        var reason = context.LastError.Reason ?? "";
        var project = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("ccofProjectId", "");
        var classification = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("ccofClassification", "");
        var period = kind == "group_quota" ? context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("ccofGroupPeriod", "") : context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("ccofPersonPeriod", "");
        var unit = period == "Hourly" ? "hour" : period == "Daily" ? "day" : period == "Weekly" ? "week" : period == "Monthly" ? "month" : period == "Yearly" ? "year" : "period";
        var adjective = period == "" ? "" : period.ToLowerInvariant() + " ";
        string type = "api_error";
        string message;
        switch (kind) {
            case "jwt":
                type = "authentication_error";
                if (reason.Contains("NotPresent")) { message = "No access token was sent. Sign in to the gateway and send the token as a Bearer token in the Authorization header."; }
                else if (reason.Contains("Expired")) { message = "Your access token has expired. Sign in again to get a new one."; }
                else if (reason.Contains("Audience")) { message = "The access token is for a different application. Request a token for this gateway's API."; }
                else if (reason.Contains("Issuer") || reason.Contains("Claim")) { message = "The access token was not issued by your organisation's Microsoft Entra tenant. Sign in with your organisation account."; }
                else { message = "The access token is not valid. Sign in again."; }
                break;
            case "admission_person":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "You sent more than 120 requests in 60 seconds. Wait for the time in the Retry-After header, then retry.";
                break;
            case "admission_resolver":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "The gateway is busy checking access. Retry in 5 seconds; your access has not changed.";
                break;
            case "person_rate":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "You have reached your tokens-per-minute limit for project " + project + ". Retry after the time in the Retry-After header.";
                break;
            case "person_quota":
                type = "permission_error";
                message = "Your " + adjective + "token quota for project " + project + " is used up. It resets at the start of the next " + unit + " (UTC). Your access is otherwise unchanged.";
                break;
            case "group_rate":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "The tokens-per-minute limit shared by classification " + classification + " in project " + project + " is reached. Retry after the time in the Retry-After header.";
                break;
            case "group_quota":
                type = "permission_error";
                message = "The " + adjective + "token quota shared by classification " + classification + " in project " + project + " is used up. It resets at the start of the next " + unit + " (UTC). Your own access is unchanged.";
                break;
            case "family_person_rate_exceeded":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "Your token rate limit for this model family is exceeded. Retry after the indicated interval.";
                break;
            case "family_group_rate_exceeded":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "Your group's token rate limit for this model family is exceeded. Retry after the indicated interval.";
                break;
            case "family_person_quota_exceeded":
                type = "permission_error";
                message = "Your token quota for this model family is used up for this quota period.";
                break;
            case "family_group_quota_exceeded":
                type = "permission_error";
                message = "Your group's token quota for this model family is used up for this quota period.";
                break;
            case "backend_credential":
                message = "The gateway could not get a credential for the model service. Your access is unaffected. Retry in 5 seconds; if this continues, tell your platform team.";
                break;
            case "backend_unreachable":
                message = "The model service could not be reached. Retry shortly.";
                break;
            case "backend_timeout":
                message = "The model service did not answer in time. Retry shortly.";
                break;
            case "not_found":
                type = "not_found_error";
                message = "This gateway does not serve the requested path or method. Check the endpoint path.";
                break;
            default:
                message = "The gateway hit an unexpected error. Retry; if this continues, tell your platform team.";
                break;
        }
        return new JObject(
            new JProperty("type", "error"),
            new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                new JProperty("type", type),
                new JProperty("message", message + " Request id: " + context.RequestId.ToString() + ".")))).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
    }" />
    <choose>
      <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["ccofErrorRetryAfter"] != "")">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="@((int)context.Variables["ccofErrorStatus"])" reason="@((int)context.Variables["ccofErrorStatus"] == 403 ? "Forbidden" : ((int)context.Variables["ccofErrorStatus"] == 429 ? "Too Many Requests" : "Service Unavailable"))" />
          <set-header name="Retry-After" exists-action="override">
            <value>@((string)context.Variables["ccofErrorRetryAfter"])</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-header name="x-ccof-request-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@(context.RequestId.ToString())</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>@((string)context.Variables["ccofErrorBody"])</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
      <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["ccofErrorKind"] == "jwt")">
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="401" reason="Unauthorized" />
          <set-header name="WWW-Authenticate" exists-action="override">
            <value>Bearer</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-header name="x-ccof-request-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@(context.RequestId.ToString())</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>@((string)context.Variables["ccofErrorBody"])</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </when>
      <otherwise>
        <return-response>
          <set-status code="@((int)context.Variables["ccofErrorStatus"])" reason="@{
              switch ((int)context.Variables["ccofErrorStatus"]) {
                  case 403: return "Forbidden";
                  case 404: return "Not Found";
                  case 429: return "Too Many Requests";
                  case 502: return "Bad Gateway";
                  case 503: return "Service Unavailable";
                  case 504: return "Gateway Timeout";
                  default: return "Internal Server Error";
              }
          }" />
          <set-header name="Content-Type" exists-action="override">
            <value>application/json</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-header name="x-ccof-request-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@(context.RequestId.ToString())</value>
          </set-header>
          <set-body>@((string)context.Variables["ccofErrorBody"])</set-body>
        </return-response>
      </otherwise>
    </choose>
  </fragment>
